## Pack submission

Pack ID and version:

Describe the idea, intended difficulty, and puzzle progression.

## Authorship and license

Name each author and the SPDX license you have the right to grant. Identify any
adapted material, its source, and attribution or redistribution requirements.

## Verification

Include the results of `orifude verify PATH` and `orifude solve PATH`.
Describe how you played every puzzle and any feedback from another player.

## Changes to an existing pack

Link the earlier version and describe changed puzzles or text. Keep the old
version directory intact. Use stable IDs for the same pack and puzzles.

A maintainer reviews the puzzles, text, authorship, and license before publishing.
Passing CI alone does not approve a pack.
